newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Air One starts flying Milan-London route.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Air One starts flying Milan-London route.

text.p: Italian private airline Air One said it will launch its first scheduled international route on Friday with a new Milan-London service.
Air One will use Boeing 737s for the twice-daily flights between Milan's Linate airport and London's Stansted.
The London service will also mark the inauguration of Air One's new Business Class, a statement said.
Travellers will have a choice of five flights a day on the route due to an agreement between Air One and Air UK.
Milan-London is Italy's main international route by traffic volume with 1.14 million passengers in 1996.
Air One began operating in 1995, carried some 700,000 passengers on Italian domestic flights last year, and competes successfully with flag carrier Alitalia particularly on the Milan-Rome route.
